notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of 6 or greater.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding {C}{C}.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, causing you to put it on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Arashin Sovereign into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
